title: skimseq pipeline parameters
description: Parameters for analysing low- or variable-coverage whole-genome sequencing data with skimseq.

slurm_account.description: SLURM account used for job submission.

samplesheet.description: CSV samplesheet describing input samples and FASTQ files.

mito_contig.description: Name of the mitochondrial contig in the reference genome.

intermediate_input_options.title: Intermediate input options
intermediate_input_options.description: Locations and validation behaviour for reusable intermediate files.

cram_store.description: Absolute path, or path relative to launchDir, containing reusable CRAM files.

gvcf_store.description: Absolute path, or path relative to launchDir, containing reusable GVCF files.

use_existing_cram.description: Reuse CRAM files in cram_store when available.

use_existing_gvcf.description: Reuse GVCF files in gvcf_store when available.

skip_cram_validation.description: Skip validation of existing CRAM files.

skip_gvcf_validation.description: Skip validation of existing GVCF files.

parallelisation_options.title: Parallelisation options
parallelisation_options.description: Controls for dividing reads, genomic intervals, genotypes and variants into chunks.

hc_bases_per_chunk.description: Approximate aligned bases per GATK HaplotypeCaller interval.

jc_genotypes_per_chunk.description: Approximate genotypes per GATK GenotypeGVCFs interval.

mp_bases_per_chunk.description: Approximate aligned bases per bcftools mpileup interval.

min_interval_gap.description: Minimum missing-data gap used to separate genomic intervals.

reference_masking_options.title: Reference masking options
reference_masking_options.description: Reference masking and mappability settings used for genotyping, not alignment.

min_chr_length.description: Minimum contig length used to classify a contig as a chromosome.

include_bed.description: Optional BED file defining intervals to include for genotyping.

use_reference_hardmasks.description: Use hard-masked N bases already present in the reference genome.

use_reference_softmasks.description: Use soft-masked lowercase bases already present in the reference genome.

exclude_bed.description: Optional BED file defining intervals to exclude.

exclude_padding.description: Padding added to excluded intervals in base pairs.

genotype_masked_bases.description: Genotype bases masked by selected masking methods.

filter_masked_variants.description: Remove variants overlapping masked bases from the VCF.

numt_max_gap.description: Maximum gap between NUMT alignments in one region.

minibwa_preset.description: Alignment preset: adap (adaptive short reads), sr (short reads), or lr (long reads).

minibwa_min_seed_length.description: Minimum exact-match seed length used during alignment.

minibwa_max_seed_occurrence.description: Ignore seeds occurring more than N times in the reference.

mitochondrial_options.title: Mitochondrial consensus-calling options
mitochondrial_options.description: Thresholds used to generate fixed-length mitochondrial consensus sequences from original and shifted mitochondrial pileups.

mito_shift.description: Number of bases used to rotate the mitochondrial reference.

mito_breakpoint_window.description: Number of bases at each end of the original mitochondrial reference where consensus calls are taken from the shifted-reference pileup to reduce circular-breakpoint artefacts.

mito_minbq.description: Minimum base quality for mitochondrial allele counting.

mito_minmq.description: Minimum mapping quality for mitochondrial allele counting.

mito_trim_read_ends.description: Number of bases to ignore from each end of each read before mitochondrial allele counting. Use 0 to keep all read bases.

mito_min_depth.description: Minimum total depth required to call a mitochondrial consensus base. Total depth includes A/C/G/T support plus non-SNV evidence. Sites below this threshold are masked as N.

mito_major_af.description: Minimum major allele fraction required to call an A/C/G/T mitochondrial consensus base. Major allele fraction is calculated from A/C/G/T support only.

mito_het_af.description: Minimum second-allele fraction required to emit an IUPAC ambiguity code when mito_het_mode is set to iupac.

mito_het_min_depth.description: Minimum read support required for the second allele before an IUPAC ambiguity code can be emitted.

mito_max_non_snv_af.description: Maximum allowed fraction of non-SNV evidence before masking the site as N. Non-SNV evidence includes alleles that are not exactly A, C, G, or T, such as deletion markers, insertion-like alleles, or complex alleles.

mito_het_mode.description: How to handle mixed SNV sites where the major allele does not pass mito_major_af. Use N to mask unresolved mixed sites, or iupac to emit ambiguity codes when mito_het_af and mito_het_min_depth are satisfied.

variant_caller.description: Variant caller used by the pipeline.

min_depth.description: Minimum depth to count a position as covered.

bcftools_options.title: BCFtools options
bcftools_options.description: BCFtools calling model, priors and thresholds.

bcftools_variant_prior.description: Expected substitution-rate prior used by the bcftools multiallelic caller. Higher values increase variant-calling sensitivity.

max_depth.description: Maximum reads used per input file.

vcf_filtering_options.title: VCF filtering options
vcf_filtering_options.description: Flat genotype-, sample-, population- and site-level filtering parameters. Null disables the corresponding filter.

vcf_population_min_samples.description: Minimum population size used for per-population filtering.

vcf_population_fail_mode.description: Whether all or any eligible populations must fail a population-level filter.

vcf_genotype_qual.description: Minimum genotype quality (GQ); null disables this mask.

vcf_genotype_dp_min.description: Minimum genotype depth; null disables this mask.

vcf_genotype_dp_max.description: Maximum genotype depth; null disables this mask.

vcf_sample_max_missing.description: Maximum missing-genotype fraction per sample; null disables this filter.

vcf_dp_percentile_lower.description: Lower depth percentile; null disables it.

vcf_dp_percentile_upper.description: Upper depth percentile; null disables it.

vcf_qual_global_snp.description: Minimum site QUAL for snp sites evaluated globally; null disables this filter.

vcf_qual_global_indel.description: Minimum site QUAL for indel sites evaluated globally; null disables this filter.

vcf_qual_global_invariant.description: Minimum site QUAL for invariant sites evaluated globally; null disables this filter.

vcf_dp_min_global_snp.description: Minimum site depth (INFO/DP) for snp sites evaluated globally; null disables this filter.

vcf_dp_min_global_indel.description: Minimum site depth (INFO/DP) for indel sites evaluated globally; null disables this filter.

vcf_dp_min_global_invariant.description: Minimum site depth (INFO/DP) for invariant sites evaluated globally; null disables this filter.

vcf_dist_indel_global_snp.description: Minimum distance from an indel for snp sites evaluated globally; null disables this filter.

vcf_dist_indel_global_indel.description: Minimum distance from an indel for indel sites evaluated globally; null disables this filter.

vcf_dist_indel_global_invariant.description: Minimum distance from an indel for invariant sites evaluated globally; null disables this filter.

vcf_eh_global_snp.description: Excess-heterozygosity p-value threshold for snp sites evaluated globally; null disables this filter.

vcf_eh_global_indel.description: Excess-heterozygosity p-value threshold for indel sites evaluated globally; null disables this filter.

vcf_eh_global_invariant.description: Excess-heterozygosity p-value threshold for invariant sites evaluated globally; null disables this filter.

vcf_eh_pop_snp.description: Excess-heterozygosity p-value threshold for snp sites evaluated within each population; null disables this filter.

vcf_eh_pop_indel.description: Excess-heterozygosity p-value threshold for indel sites evaluated within each population; null disables this filter.

vcf_eh_pop_invariant.description: Excess-heterozygosity p-value threshold for invariant sites evaluated within each population; null disables this filter.

vcf_hwe_global_snp.description: HWE p-value threshold for snp sites evaluated globally; null disables this filter.

vcf_hwe_global_indel.description: HWE p-value threshold for indel sites evaluated globally; null disables this filter.

vcf_hwe_global_invariant.description: HWE p-value threshold for invariant sites evaluated globally; null disables this filter.

vcf_hwe_pop_snp.description: HWE p-value threshold for snp sites evaluated within each population; null disables this filter.

vcf_hwe_pop_indel.description: HWE p-value threshold for indel sites evaluated within each population; null disables this filter.

vcf_hwe_pop_invariant.description: HWE p-value threshold for invariant sites evaluated within each population; null disables this filter.

vcf_maf_global_snp.description: Minimum allele frequency for snp sites evaluated globally; null disables this filter.

vcf_maf_global_indel.description: Minimum allele frequency for indel sites evaluated globally; null disables this filter.

vcf_maf_global_invariant.description: Minimum allele frequency for invariant sites evaluated globally; null disables this filter.

vcf_maf_pop_snp.description: Minimum allele frequency for snp sites evaluated within each population; null disables this filter.

vcf_maf_pop_indel.description: Minimum allele frequency for indel sites evaluated within each population; null disables this filter.

vcf_maf_pop_invariant.description: Minimum allele frequency for invariant sites evaluated within each population; null disables this filter.

vcf_min_samples_global_snp.description: Minimum called samples for snp sites evaluated globally; null disables this filter.

vcf_min_samples_global_indel.description: Minimum called samples for indel sites evaluated globally; null disables this filter.

vcf_min_samples_global_invariant.description: Minimum called samples for invariant sites evaluated globally; null disables this filter.

vcf_min_samples_pop_snp.description: Minimum called samples for snp sites evaluated within each population; null disables this filter.

vcf_min_samples_pop_indel.description: Minimum called samples for indel sites evaluated within each population; null disables this filter.

vcf_min_samples_pop_invariant.description: Minimum called samples for invariant sites evaluated within each population; null disables this filter.

vcf_min_callrate_global_snp.description: Minimum call rate for snp sites evaluated globally; null disables this filter.

vcf_min_callrate_global_indel.description: Minimum call rate for indel sites evaluated globally; null disables this filter.

vcf_min_callrate_global_invariant.description: Minimum call rate for invariant sites evaluated globally; null disables this filter.

vcf_min_callrate_pop_snp.description: Minimum call rate for snp sites evaluated within each population; null disables this filter.

vcf_min_callrate_pop_indel.description: Minimum call rate for indel sites evaluated within each population; null disables this filter.

vcf_min_callrate_pop_invariant.description: Minimum call rate for invariant sites evaluated within each population; null disables this filter.

output_options.title: Output options
output_options.description: Optional output files retained by the pipeline.

output_perbase_depth.description: Publish per-base depth files as bed.gz
